hero.title: The voice of shipowners under the Portuguese flag
hero.text: The Shipping Association of Portugal represents the majority of owners of ships registered in MAR – the International Shipping Register of Madeira – working with the Regional Government of Madeira, the IBC and industry to develop a strong Portuguese maritime cluster.

about.title: Representing international shipowners in MAR
about.text: EISAP is a private association representing the majority of owners of ships sailing under the Portuguese flag. Headquartered in Funchal, close to the International Business Centre of Madeira, with an office in Lisbon for direct connection with our associates.

objectives.title: Represent
objectives.text: Defend the interests of Portuguese and international shipowners with vessels registered under MAR.

objectives.title: Promote MAR
objectives.text: Contribute to the promotion, development and harmonisation of the register with IBC and the Regional Government of Madeira.

objectives.title: Develop talent
objectives.text: Support job creation for young Portuguese and European seafarers and shore staff.

objectives.title: Build the cluster
objectives.text: Foster a robust Portuguese maritime cluster with professional and academic partners.

events.title: Madeira Maritime Week & Portugal Shipping Week
events.text: Our annual meetings alternate between Madeira Maritime Week (MMW) and Portugal Shipping Week (PSW) in the Lisbon area.

members.title: Shipowners and managers from across Europe

cta.title: Own or manage ships under the Portuguese flag?
cta.text: Join EISAP to have your voice heard with the Portuguese and Madeiran authorities, connect with fellow owners and access members-only documents and briefings.
